retrievalProfile.description: A dense, airbrushed 1970s illustration featuring a pinball machine interior framed by a riveted metal border with interlocking custom lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, multi-layered composition depicting the playfield of a pinball machine, characterized by vibrant airbrushed gradients, metallic textures, and a heavy industrial frame secured with visible screws and rivets.
coreVisualRelationships: A heavy riveted metal frame containing a central illustrative window
Interlocking display text at the top integrated into the frame structure
Central title text featuring lightning bolt extensions and thick outlines
Circular bumpers and flippers acting as secondary focal points for smaller text
coreInvariants: Visible screw heads or rivets along the outer border
Airbrushed color gradients transitioning from warm oranges to cool blues
Heavy black outlines on all primary graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The pinball playfield occupies the central 80% of the frame, with a large title centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top header text and the central 'Life Machine' style title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top header down to the central title, then circulate through the bumpers and flippers at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is 'horror vacui' with dense detail filling every corner.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm oranges and yellows representing internal machine lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blues and teals in the metallic frame and background sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red and yellow for bumpers and interactive elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with dramatic value shifts from deep shadows to bright airbrushed highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight display sans and slab serif
letterConstructionRules: Thick black outlines with inner color gradients
Lightning bolt terminals on horizontal strokes
Curvilinear, liquid-like forms for secondary titles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top header are physically connected to form a single block
The 'L' and 'M' in the central title extend into jagged lightning shapes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine heavy interlocking display headers with smaller, high-contrast serif text inside circular containers.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, interlocking style of the 70s era.
Provides the necessary weight and rounded terminals for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a pinball machine playfield with bumpers, flippers, and a central eye motif, framed by a weathered blue metal border with visible rivets.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom interlocking lettering in the top header area and a lightning-bolt styled title in the center using vector outlines with thick black strokes and yellow-to-green gradients.

verificationChecks: Is the metal frame detailed with rivets?
Does the central title feature lightning bolt extensions?
Is the airbrush gradient effect visible on the playfield?

mustRedesign: Exact layout of the 'Value Priced' sticker
postGenerationChecks: Check for rivet consistency on the frame
Verify interlocking character strokes in the header
Ensure lightning bolts are integrated into the central text
Confirm airbrushed glow effects on bumpers
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [Subject] and place it inside a [Riveted Metal Frame] with [Interlocking Header Text] and [Airbrushed Playfield Elements] using a [1970s Psychedelic Palette].
